We can still view this as the white B wave. Look, this is zoomed out from the February low, A wave up, then a complex W, X, Y structure, and the Y wave is an A, B, C structure, and, yeah and yeah i mean what did i tell you if we break the sunday low um if we break below this swing low then there is some you know confluence of support probably in the area around 75 talked about that today in the previous update yeah so that would naturally be the next support level the levels are all on the chart here yeah i mean this the video can always only be a snapshot it really only tells you what happens right now but markets are dynamic process so the videos to a degree are a bit limited because if we now go a little bit lower see a strong reaction to the upside yeah then you know we need to immediately track the next resistance the the next support. So please understand this is a short-term view, short-term snapshot of what the market is doing right now.
